rows.claim: Institutional paymasters select the form knowledge takes: Han dynasty bureaus funded discrete procedures that hold until the next audit while European institutions funded universal laws, and the same funding-shape selection operates on 21st-century AI-lab questions.
rows.quote: the questions that get funded are the questions that get answered. That is as true for Han dynasty bureaus as it is for 21st-century AI labs.
rows.steal: In the next driving-ladder spend review, tag each funded dispatch with which question shape it pays for (procedure vs universal law) and add the tag line to its usage receipt: one sitting, landing spot memory/runs/hermes_burn/usage.jsonl annotations or the next burn receipt.
rows.falsifier: A sustained corpus from one funded institution that systematically answers only questions its paymaster never asked would kill the funding-shapes-answers law.

rows.claim: Personality vectors extracted from text correlate with measured traits only weakly (r approx 0.26-0.30 per the 2022 meta-analysis cited in the transcript) and historical prose is worse-confounded by genre, scribe, and translation, so trait vectors are style priors that must carry confidence intervals, never recovered psychometric ground truth.
rows.quote: Treat OCEAN vectors as **style constraints**, not recovered souls.
rows.steal: Audit mag/claritas.py's face labels: mark any trait-like score riding as ground truth as a prior-with-interval in its docstring or comments, one sitting, landing spot mag/claritas.py plus its next receipt.
rows.falsifier: A pipeline extracting OCEAN from historical prose that hits r above 0.7 against instrumented ground truth with no train/test leakage would falsify the weak-prior law.

rows.claim: A bibliography graduates to shippable only per-citation, by confirming each reference exists in the record: the transcript's audit caught 'Penix-Titus et al. 2021' as a ghost, and a live WebSearch probe this ask (5 name variants: Penix-Titus, Penix-Titmus, Penix-Tadlock, Penix alone) still returns no such paper, so the catch holds as of 2026-10-02.
rows.quote: Do not ship a bibliography that contains a ghost citation.
rows.steal: Before registering any salon or deep-research output as a corpus holding, fetch-confirm every named citation and log ghosts by name in the intake receipt: one batch per sitting, landing spot watch/inbox/ intake receipts.
rows.falsifier: A verifiable indexed record (DOI plus full text) surfacing for a paper the audit called ghost would kill this instance's verdict and demand a re-audit of the gate's precision.

rows.claim: The hard part of agent memory is recall, not extraction: a knowledge-graph memory extracted fine but failed because agents kept asking the wrong neighborhood of the graph, while the stack that survived was deliberately boring structure (Postgres, a compacting summary tree, workers rewriting wiki pages).
rows.quote: Extraction was fine. Recall was the pain: agents kept asking the wrong neighborhood of the graph. What stuck for us was boring: Postgres, a compacting summary tree, and workers that rewrite wiki pages.
rows.steal: When corpus_search next decays to scan fallback (the B2-465 disease), log which neighborhood the failing queries asked for versus what the FTS index held: one sitting, landing spot an analysis note under logs/ or watch/inbox/.
rows.falsifier: A knowledge-graph memory whose recall accuracy equals or beats a summary-tree baseline at equal corpus size and query mix would falsify the recall-pain law for that regime.

rows.claim: Durable shared state outlives model choice: multi-model workflows assign roles to interchangeable models around persistent state, so the durable asset is the state and the role definitions, not any model.
rows.quote: The practical shift is that models become replaceable workers around durable state. The vault stays. The models rotate.
rows.steal: At the next model swap (tier-ladder climb or downgrade), prove rotation costs nothing durable by diffing watch/inbox/INDEX.json before and after the swap to show receipts and hashes survived untouched: one sitting.
rows.falsifier: A workflow where swapping the model class forces rewriting durable state (receipts, indexes, laws) to keep functioning would falsify the rotation-is-free law.
